sky cinema premiere.title: Supergirl
sky cinema premiere.desc: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Supergirl reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion for an interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

sky cinema action.title: Bumblebee
sky cinema action.desc: On the run in the year 1987, Bumblebee the Autobot finds refuge in a junkyard in a small California beach town. When 17-year-old Charlie revives him, she quickly learns that this is no ordinary yellow Volkswagen.

sky cinema action.title: Jurassic Park III
sky cinema action.desc: Dr Alan Grant reluctantly accompanies a rich couple who are searching for their teenage son who crashed on the second Jurassic Park island while paragliding. Unfortunately for the adventurers, there are many unfamiliar - and deadly - dinosaurs lurking in the jungle.

sky cinema action.title: Jurassic World
sky cinema action.desc: Jurassic Park is now called Jurassic World, a fully functional dinosaur park that sees 20,000 visitors a year, the realisation of owner John Hammond's dreams. The scientists may have gone too far in creating some sort of hybrid dinosaur, which escapes and terrorises the park.

sky cinema action.title: Batman
sky cinema action.desc: In an attempt to avenge the violent death of his parents, Bruce Wayne fights to rid the city of crime and in particular, his nemesis the Joker. However, his defences come down when an attractive journalist tries to track down the truth behind sightings of a huge bat-like figure in the sky.

sky cinema family.title: The BFG
sky cinema family.desc: A 10-year-old girl, Queen Victoria and the Big Friendly Giant must devise a plan to get rid of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and all the other bad giants once and for all.

sky cinema family.title: Peter Rabbit
sky cinema family.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

sky cinema family.title: Peter Rabbit 2
sky cinema family.desc: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

sky cinema family.title: Wicked
sky cinema family.desc: An unlikely friendship emerges between Elphaba and Glinda, two clashing witches in the magical land of Oz. Elphaba is wrongfully cast as a wicked witch as she seeks to expose the fraudulent, corrupt Wizard who rules the land.

sky cinema family.title: Wicked: For Good
sky cinema family.desc: Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.

sky cinema comedy.title: Twinless
sky cinema comedy.desc: Two men who lost their respective twin brothers develop a growing friendship after meeting in a support group. However, both harbour long-hidden secrets that threaten to tear them apart.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan
sky cinema comedy.desc: An action movie star must protect baby pandas from a group of mercenaries.

sky cinema comedy.title: Panda Plan 2: The Magical Tribe
sky cinema comedy.desc: Jackie Chan and panda Hu Hu stumble upon a hidden jungle society that hails the panda as a "divine beast." Jackie must face a group of tribal warriors to protect his panda friend and uncover the ancient secrets of the mysterious land.

sky cinema comedy.title: American Pie: Reunion
sky cinema comedy.desc: Outrageous antics ensue when Jim, Michelle, Stifler and the gang get back together for their 13-year high school reunion.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Logan's Run
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: In 2274, computers rule a hermetically sealed city housing the survivors of a holocaust that has decimated the earth. Life is hedonistic and happy for the city's inhabitants; unfortunately they must be terminated when they reach 30. When Logan 5, a trained hunter for the system, grows intrigued by a beautiful young woman, he is forced to question the fundamental principles of his society and decides he must flee.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Assassin's Creed
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A descendant of the mysterious secret society known as the Assassins uses his newfound knowledge and physical skills to battle the power-hungry Templar Order.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Nosferatu
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A new bride is left under the care of friends when her husband travels to Transylvania for a meeting with Count Orlok. Plagued by horrific visions and an increasing sense of dread, she soon encounters an evil force that's far beyond her control.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Constantine
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Supernatural tale based on the cult comic book `Hellblazer'. Chain-smoking loner Constantine tries to buy his place in heaven by banishing earth-bound demons back to hell, but his fate is tied up with Angela, a policewoman investigating the alleged suicide of her twin.

sky cinema thriller.title: RocknRolla
sky cinema thriller.desc: Small-time crooks One Two and Mumbles decide to legitimately invest in some prime real estate and find themselves out of their depth and in debt to old-school London gangster Lenny Cole. Cole himself is in the middle of a business deal with a Russian gangster, but when his accountant tips off One Two and Mumbles to the details of an upcoming big-money business transaction, the two scallywags swoop in and steal the cash.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws 2
sky cinema thriller.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

sky cinema thriller.title: Jaws III
sky cinema thriller.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bank Job
sky cinema thriller.desc: London, 1971: Terry Leather's ex-girlfriend Martine turns up with a tempting proposition. A bank's alarm is scheduled to be turned off for a week, so Terry and his team tunnel through to the vault from a neighbouring property.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek Generations
sky cinema greats.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soren. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek: First Contact
sky cinema greats.desc: Picard and his crew face a Borg offensive as they try to ensure that a 21st-century scientist keeps a date with destiny.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
sky cinema greats.desc: The crew of the Enterprise learns of a plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, and Capt Picard begins an open rebellion to defend the planet's people as well as the very ideals the Federation was founded.

sky cinema greats.title: Mad Max
sky cinema greats.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.

sky cinema greats.title: Mad Max 2: The Road Warrior
sky cinema greats.desc: Fast-paced apocalyptic adventure. In a hostile post-World War III world, petrol is the most precious commodity and people will do anything to get it. Embittered lone warrior Max agrees to help when an oil-producing community comes under attack from a violent gang determined to get its hands on their fuel.

sky cinema drama.title: The Breakfast Club
sky cinema drama.desc: Five school kids - an athlete, a spoiled rich kid, a brainy nerd, an introverted loner and a rebellious punk - are brought together on a day-long detention where they break the rules, bare their souls and find they have more in common than just attending the same high school.

sky cinema drama.title: Moneyball
sky cinema drama.desc: Faced with a tight budget, a baseball manager and his partner recruit bargain bin players that scouts have labelled as flawed, but have game-winning potential.

sky cinema drama.title: Better Man
sky cinema drama.desc: The true story of the meteoric rise, dramatic fall, and remarkable resurgence of British pop superstar Robbie Williams.

sky cinema drama.title: A Star Is Born
sky cinema drama.desc: Hard-drinking country music star Jackson Maine discovers, and falls in love with, a struggling but talented singer named Ally. As her career quickly takes off, Jackson starts to realize that his best days may be behind him.
